title: AS2 compiler: eval(str) not implemented — should emit ActionGetVariable
description: In Flash AS2/AVM1, eval(str) is a special form that evaluates a string as a variable path — it emits ActionGetVariable with the string expression on the stack (equivalent to the AVM1 opcode 0x1C). The AS2 compiler currently has no handling for eval() — it would fall through to ActionCallFunction for 'eval', which is wrong. eval() usage is uncommon but present in older Flash content. Implementation: in compiler.ts, detect CallExpression with callee=Identifier('eval') and emit: (1) compile the argument, (2) ActionGetVariable (0x1C).
